A large and luxurious '''apartment''' was the residence of [[Vlaçan Umber]] and his wife [[Kirma Umber]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. It was located in [[Manarai Hills]], an upper-class district on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
